inputs.text: DHS is using this arrest to push a political story: New York City’s release becomes proof, in their telling, that sanctuary policies are a public-safety threat. The timing and framing look less like a neutral account of one case and more like an effort to turn immigration enforcement into a weapon against the city. They want people focused on fear and blame, not on who benefits from escalating the fight between local authorities and the federal government.
